page.overview:
Who is Yoru?

Famine Devil (older sister) Nayuta (younger sister) † Makima (sister) † Asa Mitaka (former host)

Following her taking over Mitaka's body, Yoru sets out to locate Chainsaw Man, whom secretly attends the Fourth East High School with them. She also coerces Asa into looking for a target to seduce and turn into a weapon. They choose Denji, however they eventually fail and lose their memories. After a meeting with the Death Devil, she becomes a secret member of the Chainsaw Man Church.

After defeating Pochita and regaining her power through the increased fear of war, Yoru planned on erasing the Death Devil to enact a never-ending World War II.

Following the battle with the Four Horsemen and Weapon Devils, Yoru was also reduced to a “near-death state”, due to Pochita consuming most of her body. In this state, she claimed the body of a Nightjar bird, with its form changing to a beige-colored owl or potoo appearance with a piercing gaze. While her bird form is similar to Pochita's dog form, her true form isn't shown. The recognizable ringed Horsemen's eyes are also present in this form.

Also known as: War Devil, Yoru the War Devil.
